coverage_requirements: Each frozen source/block appears exactly once across reviewer subsets, including failed/refused blocks.
Every raster page of any admitted block is visually reviewed.
Table-to-neighbor associations are retained; block decisions are separate.
decision_scope: Qualified source inspection views only; no semantic question/evidence-pack/reference admission.
public_boundary: Counts, source identities, DOM locators, byte anchors, categorical checks/reasons and hashes only. Values, source/CSS excerpts and detailed mappings remain external.
role_statement: Separate reviewers inspect disjoint source subsets. No independent duplicate annotation or inter-annotator agreement is claimed.
source_index_authority: Order in the separately frozen v17 natural-render protocol; each reviewer receipt must bind that protocol and exact execution result before reviewing artifacts.
